request: Add a check in the accounts views that validates the post-login `next` URL is one of our own pages.

summary.result_text:
I added the check, but I haven't run it because the test command needs your approval and wasn't approved.

**What I found:** `hc/accounts/views.py` already called `_allow_redirect(...)` in four places: `_redirect_after_login`, `_check_2fa`, `login`, and a fourth call near line 863. That function wasn't defined anywhere. The file only had a weaker `_allow_next_url`, which accepted any path starting with `/`. It also already defined an unused `POST_LOGIN_ROUTES` allow-list and imported `urlparse`, `resolve` and `Resolver404`.

**What I changed:** I replaced `_allow_next_url` with `_allow_redirect`, so the existing calls now work. It accepts a `next` value only if all of these hold:
- It's non-empty and has no backslashes or control characters.
- It has no scheme or host, and isn't protocol-relative (`//…`).
- Its path resolves to a view whose URL name is in `POST_LOGIN_ROUTES` (checks, details, log, channels, add-slack/pushover/telegram, project-settings, uncloak).

Anything else falls back to the default post-login redirect. That matches the existing tests, for example `/evil/` and external `https://…` URLs both fall back to the checks page.

To run the tests, use `python manage.py test hc.accounts`. The relevant ones are in `test_login.py`, `test_check_token.py` and the 2FA tests. I didn't add new tests. If you want some, the cases to cover are `//evil.com`, `/\evil.com`, and a path that resolves but isn't in `POST_LOGIN_ROUTES`, such as `/accounts/profile/`.

input.command: git status --short && git log --oneline -3 && grep -rn "_allow_redirect\|_allow_next_url\|NEXT_WHITELIST" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./hc/accounts/views.py"; sed -n 160,185p hc/accounts/tests/test_login.py; sed -n 60,80p hc/accounts/tests/test_check_token.py
